title: db82xUr
style: a high-energy industrial metal track with a driving tempo of 120 bpm in a minor key. the song features a prominent distorted electric guitar riff that establishes the main melodic and rhythmic motif. the drums provide a powerful, consistent beat with a strong emphasis on the kick and snare, utilizing a standard rock pattern with occasional fills. a synth bass provides a deep, resonant low end, often mirroring the guitar's root notes. the vocals are delivered by a male vocalist with a deep, guttural growl, maintaining a consistent aggressive tone throughout. production elements include heavy distortion on guitars and vocals, creating a dense, powerful soundscape. the mix is characterized by a forward-leaning drum and guitar presence, with the vocals sitting prominently in the center. the song structure follows a typical verse-chorus format, with instrumental breaks featuring the main guitar riff. there are no discernible chord progressions beyond the implied power chords from the guitar riff.
lyrics:
[verse]
I am the man who holds the keys
I sow the seeds and I got what you need
I live in fire, I am discord
I destroy, I am a demon

[chorus]
Ride on the world, the prize of a fighter
When they decide where you make your stand
Rise up, resist and disorder
Rise up, resist and disorder

[verse]
I'm the little man inside my den
Everything burns, everything burns
I want you down, I'll track you face down
Everything burns, everything burns

[verse]
Behind the veil is the machine
It steals your soul, devour
